name: Sea campion
note: Sea campion, Silene uniflora (docs/future/10). Drawn with the thrift shader (draw: thrift; flora-thrift.wgsl), so its keys are the thrift's: a low, loose mat of broader grey-green leaves with white flowers on short stalks, each bulging where its papery calyx swells. habitat works as in reeds.json, with the ground axes (docs/future/10): campion wants rock near the sea, from the top of the tide band up into the splash zone (shoreM, meters about mean sea level), salty and well drained, never standing water. A new island has none (starter count 0): it comes where you set rock by the sea. It flowers through summer and stays green, low, over winter. spread kind seed.
